decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine builds directly on the firm's core knowledge of precast-concrete shuttering automation and its pallet-handling processes, so the firm can interpret early customer feedback and refine the machine, even though the recent removal of four robots shows its product line turns over quickly.

Production analysis software complements the firm's installed machinery base and draws on data it already understands, giving it a low-cost learning platform that strengthens absorptive capacity rather than consuming large resources.
